gddSources.section: §08 / The debrief writes the next mission
gddSources.quote: Each open case; the block where the person was last seen gets one more posted guard and one more camera for 3 missions; the district's security level

| missing persons and cases [S] | each open case; the area watch: +1 posted guard and +1 camera on the block where the person was last seen, for 3 missions; the district's security level S | a kill never found: +2 T, no Menace, close ties fear +1, the case stays open until the body is found · a found killing: −1 Standing, grief, its case closes after 3 missions · every 2 open cases raise S by 1, at most +2 |

executionPath.finding: Between holds typed Cases and AreaWatch tuples. Takedown aftermath populates victim, kind, scene, lifetime and watch counts, then produces prose lines.

Debrief.Of computes BetweenMissions. Write emits counts/nextLevel and lines but never serializes Cases or AreaWatch. Case lines omit place; watch lines are prose, so downstream data consumers lose structured relationships.
Successful report JSON invokes Debrief.Of(g).Write; sim/cli/Program.cs:97 also invokes the same writer.

candidates.title: Connect prior open cases to the next headless mission security dial
candidates.status: missing campaign input connection; larger follow-on, defer behind bounded export

gddSources.quote: How hard a district answers is data per district and mission, not code: the security level is the district's base, plus one for every two open cases (at most two), plus the mission's own bonus. The Handover runs at level 2.

response [S] (Sky: "it's easy to swarm the play area with robots if we need to temper the game play"): a dial, data per district and mission, not code. S = the district's base (data in the plan) + ⌊open cases ÷ 2⌋ (at most +2) + the mission's bonus. The Handover runs at S2.

executionPath.finding: Explicitly says no campaign layer runs yet. Computes new cases from this mission and NextLevel from this mission count plus SecurityBase; outputs only.
Start exposes explicit Security override, but no prior case collection or open-case count; strict Only() rejects additional fields.
SecurityLevel resolves Start.Security ?? S.SecurityLevel, then selects dial data.
Site.SecurityLevel includes SecurityBase + SecurityBonus, with no case input.
Exporter already passes plan base and mission bonus to provisional data. Missing connection is campaign state, not those authored inputs.

existingTests.covers: One newly open case does not increase next district level. No next-mission start from prior cases.
Start-state replay plumbing must remain deterministic.

smallestChange.description: Bounded first slice: optional prior open-case count in Start, canonicalized and hashed; absent explicit scenario override, derive dial from base + capped case increment + bonus. This proves input-to-dial only, not persistence or case aging.

blockersDependencies: Aster/Keel must define campaign handoff semantics: an input count alone does not persist victims, close found-killing cases after three missions or resolve discovered missing bodies.
Full carry-forward/area guard-camera application needs campaign ownership and generated-world integration beyond a small shared-sim task.
Preserve explicit Start.Security override semantics and historical canonical hashes when new field absent.
Do not add mission bonus to NextLevel blindly: it currently represents projected district level, whereas SecurityLevel is mission-specific.
acceptanceChecks: For base 2 and bonus 0, prior cases 0/1 -> S2, 2/3 -> S3, 4+ -> S4; cap increment at two and overall level at four.
Verify a nonzero mission bonus is added once, and explicit Security override remains authoritative.
Reject invalid negative case input; round-trip canonical Start and replay with identical checksums; absent case input preserves existing behavior.
Two successive headless mission starts must eventually consume produced consequences; mark this requirement incomplete until that consumer exists.
